faqItems.question: How much does it cost to hire a Next.js developer?
faqItems.answer: The cost depends on the developer's experience, the complexity of your website or application, the integrations involved, the engagement model and how long you need the developer. We provide a project-specific estimate once we understand your requirements.

faqItems.question: What type of Next.js developers can I hire?
faqItems.answer: You can hire Next.js Frontend Developers, Full-Stack Next.js Developers, Next.js + Headless CMS Developers, Next.js SEO & Performance Developers, Next.js E-commerce Developers, Next.js + TypeScript Developers, Next.js Migration Developers and Next.js Dashboard Developers.

faqItems.question: What technologies do your Next.js developers work with?
faqItems.answer: Our Next.js developers work with Next.js, React and TypeScript; Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion; REST and GraphQL APIs; databases such as MongoDB and PostgreSQL; headless platforms such as Strapi, Contentful, Sanity and Shopify; and hosting on Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare or Netlify.

faqItems.question: Is Next.js a good choice for SEO?
faqItems.answer: Next.js supports server-side rendering and static generation, which help search engines crawl and index your pages. Our developers also set up page metadata, sitemaps and structured data as part of the build.
